definitions.explanation: A favorable time or situation that makes it possible to do something.

examples.japanese: これは{大|おお}きなチャンスだ。
チャンスを{逃|のが}さないで。
{海外|かいがい}で{働|はたら}くチャンスをもらった。
examples.english: I got the chance to work overseas.

notes:
チャンス emphasizes a favorable opportunity that should not be missed.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- チャンスを{掴|つか}む: to seize an opportunity
- チャンスを{逃|のが}す: to miss a chance
- チャンスを{活|い}かす: to make use of an opportunity
- チャンスを{与|あた}える: to give a chance
- チャンスを{待|ま}つ: to wait for a chance
- ラストチャンス: last chance

RELATED WORDS:
- {機会|きかい}: opportunity (more formal)
- {好機|こうき}: good opportunity (formal)
- {可能性|かのうせい}: possibility

[Register: Neutral]
